chapter: First jobs and finding his sound
title: Goofus Carnell, Idlewilde and meeting Thad and Hank Jones
summary: He met Thad and Hank Jones in Pontiac and Goofus Carnell put a band together for a summer at Idlewilde.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: I'm interested in how that job came
up; who knew you from the early band...?

When I look back, I don't know how this happened...Oh, oh yes I do know how it happened. I met...after I got started playin' pretty good... I met Thad Jones and Hank Jones in Pontiac which was 30 or 35 miles from my home. Goofus Carnell...now it all comes back to me...Goofus Carnell, he took us to... oh, we did some things with Goofus Carnell and he come to Lansing, Michigan, and he had heard about us from somewhere and he said, "Let's do something." So we went up to, one summer, we went up to Idlewilde. We did a whole summer up there and Chauncy Donaldson, Kansas City, he was in charge of the band and Goofus-- I look back on him and he played fair trumpet--but he looked like...he had a funny look about him, that's why everybody called him Goofus, Carnell, he looked Goofus, ya dig. Hahahaha. Well he was a pretty smart businessman. So the deal went down. He got us together, then we...Thad and Hank and then this Howard Brockington from my hometown was playin' trumpet.
Were Thad and Hank in the same band?
